results.title: Samsung Electro-Mechanics wins KRW360.5 billion memory substrate deal as AI demand drives expansion
results.description: Samsung Electro-Mechanics has secured a KRW360.5 billion (US$271.8 million) long-term contract to supply package substrates for memory semiconductors, strengthening its position in the growing AI server component market.
